_note: Danny's pre-episode reads for Survivor: David vs. Goliath. Written after watching each episode, before the next one airs. Never contains results.

2.note: Natalie clearly first for Goliath; nobody else there stands out and Mike/Angelina are safe this early. David tribe is an even spread. Doubles favour Goliath on challenge strength.

3.note: No strong read. Nobody votes Mike or Christian; outside those it's pretty split. Doubles still favour Goliath.

4.note: Merge teased, so the read is weak. Nobody votes Christian, Mike or John. No fresh boot read, so episode 3's names carry forward — the room's sense of who is exposed rarely resets week to week. Double targets are held very lightly: the names with some standing, not a confident call.

5.note: Natalie Cole the clear #1 (70%+ expect the vote); Lyrsa/Kara/Davie/Alison the next tier. Doubles steer away from Jabeni (purple). A decent share of bots should diverge.

6.note: Boot read (in order): Lyrsa, Kara, Angelina, Gabby, Alison. Doubles favour the Tiva tribe (Alison/Christian/Dan/Gabby/John) plus Mike White. Neither list is universal — a good share of bots should diverge onto castaways not named here.

8.note: Wide-open first post-merge vote, no strong read. Slight lean to Carl/Angelina/Davie/Kara/Alec/Christian/Dan; Alison and Gabby next; Nick outside that; Mike and John safest. Bots should diverge widely. Doubles nudge toward advantage-holders (Dan/Davie/Carl/Nick) and challenge threats John/Alison — but near-even.

9.note: No real read. Spread the vote about evenly across the eleven, with a nudge toward Christian and Angelina. Doubles are unsteered — whoever backs their roster picks at random.

11.note: Christian is the read — should draw the most ballots (~14), with the vote-doublers piling on him. Angelina a clear second (~8), fewer doubling her. The other six split about evenly and low. Roster-point doubles are unsteered: whoever holds a roster member backs one at random.

12.note: Christian and Alison the leans again, but lighter and less confident than ep11 after the blindsides — a flatter split, the pack (Angelina/Davie/Kara/Mike/Nick) close behind at even weight. Roster-point doubles spread evenly across all seven (engine can't finely de-weight Christian/Alison; even spread is the closest to 'a couple fewer on them').
